name: Goncharov
source:
A short visual novel about time, dreams and regrets.

[From [url=https://martinscorsese.itch.io/goncharov]Itch.io[/url]]

Visual novel adaptation of a [url=https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/goncharov]Tumblr meme[/url] about a non-existent movie directed by Martin Scorsese.
translation:
一部關於時間、夢想與悔恨的短篇視覺小說。

[引自[url=https://martinscorsese.itch.io/goncharov]Itch.io[/url]]

本作改編自一則[url=https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/goncharov]Tumblr網路迷因[/url]：馬丁．史柯西斯導演了一部並不存在的電影。
